referenceTitle: WHO/FAO food and irrigation-water limits for lead, cadmium and chromium
reason: Grouped WHO/FAO citation has no document title, URL or edition identifying food and irrigation benchmarks. Secondary papers repeat inconsistent units/bases. The primary FAO irrigation table reviewed lists lead 5.0 mg/L, not the claimed 0.5 mg/L, and cannot identify or verify this entire grouped reference.

evidence.note: Read Table 21, trace-element irrigation guidelines and application-rate footnote. Lead row (misprinted Pd on the HTML page) is 5.0 mg/L; criteria protect irrigation use and do not establish a combined dry-food WHO standard.
